incident_text: De fortes inondations touchent un quartier résidentiel de Nabeul. Plusieurs routes sont bloquées et l'eau continue de monter.

result.scene_summary: A flooded urban square with buildings partially submerged in muddy water under an overcast sky.

observations.description: A large area of murky, brown water covers the entire square, reaching up to the bases of buildings.
Multi-story buildings with traditional European architecture, including arched doorways, windows, and balconies, are partially submerged.
A traffic signpost with a stop sign and a blue directional arrow is visible on the right side of the frame.
A small white object, possibly a bag or container, is floating in the water on the left.
